name: 38787-longprefill-qwen35a3b-2gpu
hardware: 2x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, two GPUs of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. Two GPUs is the fewest that hold 66.97 GiB of bf16 weights with a usable cache left over.
architecture: Hybrid linear-attention / full-attention sparse mixture-of-experts (`Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration`), bf16, ~35 B parameters with ~3 B active per token; the layer table, head counts and expert counts are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, bounded at 1280 requests / 3600 s safety, with a 20% warmup (256) and a 5% cooldown (64) by completion, so 960 requests are measured -- the source issued 256 warmups IN ADDITION to its 1024 measured requests, and guidellm counts the warmup inside its request bound.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 8580 tokens and output exactly 128 (min = max on both; `ignore_eos` pins the output), `request_format: plain` at `temperature: 0.0` so no chat template is applied, Faker-generated synthetic English, seed 38787. Prefix caching is off, so every request prefills its whole prompt.
purpose: A long-document analysis service on two GPUs, handling 64 concurrent 8,500-token prompts with short summary replies.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B

tensor-parallel-size: 2
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
trust-remote-code: true

gdn-prefill-backend: triton
